notes.title: Improvements and changes in version 0.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33746884/650114a31381382d70f3067e67e614f859ad0555.jpg[/img]

The progress of all players is cleared.
Fixed a bug due to which the server’s network connections were limited.
Improved matchmaking system. Now the player can not be sent to the far stage if he has not yet reached this stage himself.
Added notification if you are being transferred to the far stage.
The waiting time for different stages was reconfigured in order to increase the speed of the beginning of the game for players in the early stages so that more real winners would get to the far stages rather than artificially elevated players.
Added display of the number of players waiting and required for the start of the stage.
Fixed a bug due to which the fights of the 3rd stage did not work, since only one player got there who had to commit suicide to continue the game.
An interface bug has been fixed, due to which sometimes the icons of the received improvements could not be seen.
Fixed a bug due to which shells could remain forever in the air. Required to double-check.
Added display of all types of death events and leaving the battle.
Added display of the number of remaining enemies.
Added the ability to choose a weapon in the right hand. New items are available on every second player level.
Now you can choose a character and items from the controller without using the mouse.
Fixed a bug due to which the controller was not used on the battle results screen.
The language of the game is now automatically selected depending on the language settings in Steam (Properties / Language).
At the start of the battle now the control keys are displayed.
Added display of the key for a bomb and a shield activation.
In the game settings added volume control of music and sound.
In the game settings, added reassignment of control keys.
When you first start the game, now full screen mode is selected by default.
Reworked the dungeon scene in the initial menu, as it was too demanding for low-pc.
Reduced the radius and damage from the explosion of barrels.
Improved the visibility of the skill icon on the pick up object.
Slightly reduced the movement speed of the character and the speed of the projectiles, so that the effect of the improvements would be more noticeable.
The values of some improvements were balanced.
Added death of a character if you managed to jump out of the dungeon.

notes.title: Closed Testing of Dungellion will start on December 7th!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33746884/eaa844dc843edaaf8a49299e0b3b1e6c4d1524c4.jpg[/img]

December 7th, from 9 am PST (18:00 CET) will take place the Closed Testing of Dungellion.The test session will last approximately 2 hours.

Read more about the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/935630/Dungellion/

To participate in testing, you must join to the official Dungellion Discord: http://discord.gg/ccVb7Dy  
Shortly before testing, or during it, you can get a Steam key to participate. 

How to activate the key? https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=5414-tfbn-1352

No NDA! You can stream it, publish videos, screenshots and articles about the game. 

Keep in mind that the game is at an early stage of development and you may encounter bugs and technical problems. Report any errors found in Discord, you can also tell about your impressions and share suggestions for improving the game.

Subscribe to news and participation in the following tests: https://dungellion.com/

notes.title: Learn more about the Dungellion gameplay
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33746884/a1d6d7532b355b576cd03242e37fc092293abe33.jpg[/img]

We will run a developer blog and talk about the features of Dungellion and plans for the development of the game. Today we take a closer look at the key features of the gameplay.

[h1]The basis of the game[/h1]
Players fight in arenas - small dungeons with random generation. Equidistant from the players is a chest with the improvement. In addition to the chest, there are 3 types of barrels in the dungeon: breakable, exploding, unbreakable. From the broken barrels you can get an improvement (their number depends on the number of players in the arena), or coins and recovery potions. An explosive barrel will damage everyone in a radius, and other barrels will also be broken.

[h1]Rounds[/h1]
The battle is divided into rounds. The winner is the last survivor.
The first round is in 1vs1 format. Players have a tactical choice:
[list]
[*] fight for the chest,
[*] try to find an improvement in barrels,
[*] first of all defeat the opponent.
[/list]
At the end of the battle, the winner will go to the second round, where he will fight with other winners.
The second round is in the same format, but 3 players participate. In the third and subsequent rounds will fight 4 players.

[h1]Fight, Improvements, and Synergy[/h1]
The player can shoot in 4 directions and throw bombs. The character has a number of characteristics, such as damage, size of shells, their speed of flight and other parameters. Picking up an improvement, the characteristics of the character can be changed, or a special effect (active or passive) will be added. 
Examples:
[list][*]Increasing the health and size of the character, but reducing the speed.
[*] Activated shield, temporarily reflecting all shots in the opposite direction.
[*] When hit by an enemy or an obstacle, the projectile will split into 4 smaller ones.
[*] Instead of the usual attack, you shoot bombs.[/list]

Now imagine what will happen if you combine the last two examples? Exactly! You shoot bombs that split into 4 new bombs. In Dungellion there will be many combinable improvements and skills.

Hopefully, you now have a more detailed understanding of what the Dungellion is. Next time we will consider the system of level up and rewards for matches. Follow the news.

[h1]Subscribe to participate in the beta: https://dungellion.com/[/h1]
